en.LoginNote: Idset starts in the tray when you sign in.
en.Approve: macOS needs your approval first. Open System Settings › General › Login Items & Extensions and turn on Idset.
en.LoginFail: Could not change the login item: %s
en.BackupNote: Idset backs up accounts.json before an identity is added and before a backup is restored, and keeps the newest 10. Location: ~/.config/idset/backups/.
en.ReadOnlyBanner: accounts.json cannot be read, so Idset is read-only. Restore a backup to carry on.
en.EmptyBody: Idset backs up accounts.json automatically in two cases: before an identity is added, and before a backup is restored. Editing, deleting and binding do not back up. The newest 10 are kept in ~/.config/idset/backups/.
en.ConfirmBody: The current accounts.json is backed up first, then replaced by this backup, and the configuration is regenerated. After restoring you will have these identities:
en.ConfirmNote: Identities that are not in the backup are removed from the list.
en.IncludeNote: Only the Idset marker block in ~/.ssh/config and ~/.gitconfig is deleted; everything else stays. It comes back the next time you change an identity.
en.RemovedNote: Removed. Your identities are unchanged; the marker blocks return the next time you change an identity.
en.RemoveFailPartial: Could not write %s: %s. The block in %s was already removed.
en.RemoveBody: Git and SSH stop picking an identity by folder. The marker blocks come back the next time you change an identity.
en.Kept3: Private keys and the rest of your own config

zh-Hans.LangNote: 改动立即生效，不用重启。
zh-Hans.LoginNote: 登录后 Idset 在托盘里启动。
zh-Hans.Approve: macOS 需要你先批准。打开「系统设置」›「通用」›「登录项与扩展」，打开 Idset。
zh-Hans.BackupNote: 新增身份之前和恢复备份之前，Idset 会自动备份 accounts.json，只保留最新的 10 份。位置：~/.config/idset/backups/。
zh-Hans.ReadOnlyBanner: accounts.json 读不出来，Idset 现在是只读的。恢复一份备份即可继续。
zh-Hans.EmptyBody: Idset 会在两种时候自动备份 accounts.json：新增身份之前，和恢复备份之前。编辑、删除、绑定不备份。只保留最新的 10 份，放在 ~/.config/idset/backups/。
zh-Hans.ConfirmBody: 先备份当前的 accounts.json，再用这份备份替换它，并重新生成配置。恢复后会有这些身份：
zh-Hans.ConfirmNote: 不在备份里的身份会从列表里移除。
zh-Hans.IncludeNote: 只删除 ~/.ssh/config 和 ~/.gitconfig 里 Idset 的标记块，其余内容不动。下次修改身份时会加回来。
zh-Hans.RemovedNote: 已移除。身份没有变化；下次修改身份时，标记块会加回来。
zh-Hans.RemoveFailPartial: 无法写入 %s：%s。%s 里的标记块已经移除。
zh-Hans.RemoveBody: 移除后 Git 和 SSH 不再按文件夹选身份。下次修改身份时，标记块会自动加回来。
zh-Hans.Kept3: 私钥和你自己写的其他配置
